_comment: SPA-APP-BEHIND-001 — which version of the phone/tablet app each channel actually has.
The Android app carries its OWN frozen copy of the till screens, so a web deploy does
NOT reach it. deploy-all.js reads this file and warns loudly when either channel is behind.
apk  = the newest spa-v* APK published (prerelease) on siamepos-releases. Bump with ANDROID_APK_VERSION in src/server.js.
play = the newest .aab Korakot has uploaded to Google Play Console (closed testing). Only bump
AFTER he confirms the upload. Highbury's phone sat on Play 1.5.0 for 7 weeks (27 Nov 2026)
because 1.5.1 and 1.5.2 only went out as APKs.
